## Purpose and scope

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the design and implementation plan.

## Design decisions

Explain interfaces, compatibility, and significant trade-offs.

## Privacy and security

Describe authorization, isolation, sensitive-data, and side-effect impact.

## Validation

List commands and results, negative cases, and checks that could not run.

## Operations, data, and rollback

Describe deployment, migrations, recovery, and rollback, or explain why not applicable.

## Limitations

List deferred work and unresolved decisions.

## Prompt history

Quote the user requests that led to this PR, with dates. Redact secrets and
personal data and mark redactions. List repository and user instructions followed.
